widget.resetTitle: Reset all accessibility settings to default

tools.fontSizeDesc: Increase or decrease text size for easier reading
tools.fontWeightDesc: Make text bolder for better readability
tools.lineHeightDesc: Adjust spacing between lines of text
tools.letterSpacingDesc: Increase space between characters for clarity
tools.readableFontDesc: Switch to a font designed for dyslexic readers
tools.readableFontAltDesc: Switch to Lexend — a font proven to improve reading speed and comprehension
tools.highlightLinksDesc: Make all links more visible with underlines and highlights
tools.underlineLinksDesc: Underline all text links without adding a background
tools.highlightTitlesDesc: Emphasize headings to distinguish sections clearly
tools.bigCursorDesc: Enlarge the mouse cursor for easier tracking
tools.stopAnimationsDesc: Pause all moving elements to reduce distraction
tools.readingGuideDesc: A horizontal line to help follow text while reading
tools.readingRulerDesc: Highlight a strip of text to block out distractions
tools.focusModeDesc: Dim the page except for the active section
tools.visibleFocusDesc: Show clear outlines on focused elements for keyboard navigation
tools.monochromeDesc: Remove all color for a grayscale view
tools.lowSaturationDesc: Reduce color intensity for easier viewing
tools.highContrastDesc: Increase contrast between text and background
tools.lightContrastDesc: Use a light background with dark text
tools.darkContrastDesc: Use a dark background with light text
tools.invertDesc: Flip all colors on the page — dark becomes light and vice versa
tools.hideImagesDesc: Hide all images, videos, and media elements to reduce distraction
tools.readingMaskDesc: A translucent overlay with a transparent slit that follows your mouse
tools.screenReaderDesc: Add skip links and enhance page structure for screen reader users
tools.textAlignLeftDesc: Align text to the left edge
tools.textAlignRightDesc: Align text to the right edge

profiles.seizureSafeDesc: Stops animations and reduces visual triggers for photosensitive users
profiles.visionImpairedDesc: Enlarges text, increases contrast, and enhances cursor visibility
profiles.adhdFriendlyDesc: Reduces distractions with focus mode and reading tools
profiles.cognitiveDisabilityDesc: Dyslexia-friendly font with enhanced spacing and highlighting
profiles.keyboardNavigationDesc: Visible focus indicators and enhanced cursor for motor impairments
profiles.blindUsersDesc: Maximum accessibility for screen reader and keyboard-only users
profiles.motorImpairedDesc: Big cursor, visible focus, and reduced motion for motor control difficulties
